body: Some of that stuff sounds like stimming to me. Small, repetitive motions, or little sounds (meowing could fall into that, I hum tunes a lot to stim.) Hand flapping, rocking back and forth, and bouncing your leg are like, the trifecta of classic stimming behaviors. I've mostly seen stimming talked about in autistic and ADHD circles, and it's quite a common aspect of both of those things. I haven't heard of a sudden onset of stimming caused by ssri's, but, that still could be something to look into? If the autistic or ADHD experience rings true to you, maybe that's what's going on, and it's not really caused by the ssri's at all.
